people.nameZh: 托馬斯·加里格·馬薩里克

body.zh-Hant: 馬薩里克是捷克的政治家兼哲學家，生於摩拉維亞的霍多寧。他1872至1876年在維也納大學隨布倫塔諾學哲學，1876至1877年在萊比錫度過；1879年成為維也納的編外講師，1882年起任布拉格捷克大學哲學教授。第一次世界大戰與出任捷克斯洛伐克總統，使他的學術工作告一段落。
body.en: Masaryk was a Czech statesman and philosopher, born in Hodonín, Moravia. He studied philosophy at the University of Vienna from 1872 to 1876 under Franz Brentano and spent 1876–1877 in Leipzig. He became a Privatdozent at Vienna in 1879 and in 1882 a professor of philosophy at the Czech University in Prague. The First World War and the presidency of Czechoslovakia ended his academic pursuits.

body.en: The source says he was president of Czechoslovakia from 1918 to 1935 (exact term dates are in the leader records). Its author judges that in 1918 he liberated the Czechs not only politically but also intellectually.

body.zh-Hant: 本名阿希爾·拉蒂，1857年5月31日生於米蘭附近的代西奧。1879年晉鐸，1882年成為米蘭大修院教授；1888至1911年在安布羅夏圖書館任職（1907年後任館長），1911至1918年轉到梵蒂岡圖書館，1914年後任館長（prefect）。
body.en: Born Ambrogio Damiano Achille Ratti at Desio near Milan on 31 May 1857, he was ordained in 1879 and in 1882 became a professor at the major seminary in Milan. He served on the staff of the Ambrosian Library from 1888 to 1911 (as its director after 1907), then worked at the Vatican Library from 1911 to 1918, as prefect after 1914.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年4月本篤十五世派他任駐新生波蘭共和國的宗座視察員，1919年6月任駐波蘭教廷大使。1921年6月13日本篤十五世將他調任，使他成為米蘭總主教與樞機；1922年2月6日第十四輪投票當選教宗。
body.en: In April 1918 Benedict XV sent Ratti as apostolic visitator to the young Polish Republic, and he was appointed nuncio to Poland in June 1919. Benedict XV transferred him on 13 June 1921, making him archbishop of Milan and a cardinal. He was elected pope on the fourteenth ballot on 6 February 1922.

body.zh-Hant: 莫塔1871年12月29日生於提契諾的艾羅洛，1940年1月23日卒於伯恩，天主教徒。他攻讀法律，1893年取得法學博士；自1895年到進入聯邦委員會為止，在艾羅洛當律師與公證人。1895年當選提契諾大議會，成為天主教保守黨的領導人物之一；1899年進入國民院。
body.en: Motta was born in Airolo on 29 December 1871 and died in Bern on 23 January 1940. He studied law and took his doctorate in 1893. From 1895 until his election to the Federal Council he was a lawyer and notary in Airolo. After his election to the Ticino Grand Council in 1895 he quickly became a leader of the Catholic-Conservative party, and in 1899 he entered the National Council.

body.zh-Hant: 1911年12月14日，莫塔以206票中的184票當選聯邦委員，接替孔特斯（Robert Comtesse）主管財政與關稅部。他於1915年、1920年、1927年、1932年與1937年擔任聯邦主席；1920年起接掌政治部（外交），一直主持到去世。（元首任期日期以名簿紀錄為準。）
body.en: On 14 December 1911 Motta was elected to the Federal Council with 184 of 206 votes, succeeding Robert Comtesse as head of the Finance and Customs Department. He held the Federal Presidency in 1915, 1920, 1927, 1932 and 1937; from 1920 he took over the Political Department (foreign affairs), which he led until his death. (Term dates of the presidencies are in the leader records.)

body.zh-Hant: 在政治部任內，他多次推動瑞士加入國際聯盟，1920年5月16日公民投票通過入盟。1936年12月，應他在聯邦委員會的提議，瑞士成為第一個在法律上承認義大利併吞衣索比亞的中立國。對納粹德國，他主要設法取得希特勒對瑞士中立的正式承認。他主持政治部的二十年被稱為「莫塔時代」。
body.en: In the Political Department he repeatedly advocated Swiss membership of the League of Nations; the people approved entry on 16 May 1920. On his proposal, Switzerland in December 1936 became the first neutral country to recognise the Italian annexation of Ethiopia de jure. Toward Nazi Germany he mainly sought Hitler's formal recognition of Swiss neutrality. His twenty years as head of the Political Department are known as the 'Motta era'.

body.zh-Hant: 萊吉亞1863年2月19日生，出身蘭巴耶克，在瓦爾帕萊索的英國學校學會計。太平洋戰爭後經婚姻與農業出口地主階層結盟，並與國內外銀行和保險公司建立財務關係：1896年創立英國糖業公司，1900年創立南美保險公司。他進入政壇後迅速竄起，先後在坎達莫（Manuel Candamo）與帕爾多（José Pardo）兩位總統下任財政部長。
body.en: Leguía was born on 19 February 1863 in Lambayeque and studied accounting at a British school in Valparaíso. After the War of the Pacific he was tied by marriage to agro-exporting landed interests and built financial ties with banks and insurers: he founded the British Sugar Company in 1896 and the South America Insurance Company in 1900. He rose meteorically in politics, first serving as finance minister under Presidents Manuel Candamo and José Pardo.

body.zh-Hant: 1908年他在公民黨（Civilista）支持下當選總統。首任期並不平順：1909年的一次政變企圖幾乎奪走他的性命，他的現代化改革使他失去公民黨的好感；1908至1910年間還得應付與厄瓜多、哥倫比亞、智利的國際危機。1913年後他旅居國外，主要在倫敦。（總統任期日期以名簿紀錄為準。）
body.en: Backed by the Civilista Party, he was elected president in 1908. His first term was traumatic: in an attempted coup in 1909 he almost lost his life, and his modernizing efforts cost him the Civilistas' favour; he also faced international crises with Ecuador, Colombia and Chile from 1908 to 1910. After 1913 he lived abroad, mainly in London. (Term dates are in the leader records.)

heading.en: Second period in power and fall

body.zh-Hant: 1918年他在強大民意支持下返回秘魯，1919年贏得總統選舉，但因擔心國會反對，動員軍方支持發動政變以強化總統權力。他推行「新祖國」（Patria Nueva），結果是1924年與1929年操縱連任；他把許多政敵流放或下獄。大恐慌導致其公共工程與現代化陷入困境，他被桑切斯·塞羅上校領導的軍事政變推翻，死於卡亞俄獄中。（任期日期以名簿紀錄為準。）
body.en: In 1918 he returned to Peru with strong popular support and won the 1919 presidential elections, but, fearing congressional opposition, rallied military support for a coup to reinforce his presidential powers. His 'New Fatherland' (Patria Nueva) led to rigged re-elections in 1924 and 1929, and he exiled or imprisoned many adversaries. His public works floundered in the financial crisis of the Depression; he was ousted by a military coup led by Colonel Luis Sánchez Cerro and died in prison in Callao. (Term dates are in the leader records.)
